name: Togawa Mayuu
source: A former actress who is extremely well-known in the actors' world. Mayu retired three years ago in order to treasure and spend more time with [url=/c24581]Ichigo[/url], her childhood friend. However, due to her status as the former legendary actress, she is popular at school too. She is extremely dependent of Ichigo and is almost always together with him. She is also cautious and wary of the other girls around Ichigo, especially [url=/c22754]Sena[/url].
